title: Understanding Negative Exponents
text:
A negative exponent means the reciprocal:

$$a^{-n} = \frac{1}{a^n}$$

So $a^{-5} = \frac{1}{a^5}$

title: Move Terms with Negative Exponents
text:
Move $a^{-5}$ to the denominator to make it positive:

$$2a^{-5}b^4 = \frac{2b^4}{a^5}$$

title: Final Answer
text:
The final answer with positive exponents is:

$$\frac{2b^4}{a^5}$$
